entity: INES (Institut National de l'Énergie Solaire) - plateforme formation
role: Présidente de l'association / membre du conseil d'administration
detail: President of the INES training-platform association (Jan 2019-Jun 2021), then board member of INES training/evaluation platform (Jul 2021-Jun 2023). Solar-energy institute based in Le Bourget-du-Lac (Savoie).
Board member of the Alpine Territories Agency until February 2024.

entity: Université Savoie Mont Blanc / Fondation USMB
detail: Board member of the University Savoie Mont Blanc (2019-2021) and of its Foundation (2021-2024).

entity: TENERRDIS, ASDER, Conservatoire du Littoral, SPL-S de la Savoie
detail: Board memberships (2019-2021) in regional bodies: TENERRDIS energy-transition competitiveness cluster, ASDER (Savoyard renewable-energy association), Conservatoire du Littoral, and the SPL-S de la Savoie (local public company).
